trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself — there is no separate task. The official description is the whole instruction: 'Congratulations! You're a Leonida Legend.' Treat the roadmap as the plan: story first, then the counters, then the platinum. Per the official list on Exophase, this is the set's only platinum, and PSNProfiles lists it as the completion reward. Our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first story trophy most players will earn: play the opening mission through to its end and it unlocks when the mission completes. Nothing to prepare, nothing to miss — just follow the mission as directed. Per the official list on Exophase, the description names the mission outright; our guidance is our own reading of that description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story trophies unlock as you complete each chapter, so play through Chapter 1's missions in order and this pops at the chapter's end. No side content is needed for it. Per the official list on Exophase, the trigger is the chapter itself; our advice comes from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like every chapter trophy, it unlocks when the chapter's final mission ends. Play the story straight through and it will come. The name is published exactly as PSN lists it. Per the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. A story trophy: complete the chapter and it unlocks. No collectibles, no counters, no missable step — the chapter's missions are the whole requirement. Per the official list on Exophase; our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale: complete Chapter 4's missions in order and it unlocks at the chapter's end. Per the official list on Exophase for its name, description and grade; our guidance is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This gold trophy is the story's endpoint: finish the last mission and it unlocks, and with the chapters behind you the platinum is nearly in reach. There is no alternate-ending requirement in the official description — one final mission, one trophy. Per the official list on Exophase; our advice comes from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run. A named story mission: play it through to completion and the trophy unlocks. Story missions cannot be missed — if you can still load the story, you can still finish the mission. Per the official list on Exophase, which names the mission; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A named story mission and a heist: finish it and the trophy is yours. Heist missions in the story are replayable through mission select in past GTA games, but we have not confirmed that for this game — play it clean the first time. Per the official list on Exophase; our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. A named story mission: finish it and the trophy unlocks. Nothing else is required — no collectibles, no counter. Per the official list on Exophase, which names the mission; our guidance is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. A named story mission: play it through and the trophy pops at the end. Story trophies are the safest in the set — they unlock from progress alone. Per the official list on Exophase; our advice comes from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. A named story mission at the airport: finish the takedown and the trophy unlocks. Per the official list on Exophase, which names the mission; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A named story mission: finish the operation and the trophy is yours. Per the official list on Exophase for its name, description and grade; our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The big one after the story: 100% means every mission, activity, collectible and counter in the game's own checklist. Use the in-game stats page to see what is left — this tracker mirrors it, but the game is the authority. Expect this to be the last trophy before the platinum. Per the official list on Exophase; PSNProfiles lists it as gold. Our advice is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps and aerial tricks: find ramps and jumps around Leonida and land them. The counter in this tracker (0/250) is your friend — tap + after each session. Stunts are repeatable and cannot be missed, so grind them whenever you are between missions. Per the official list on Exophase for the target of 250; PSNProfiles confirms the count. Our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Not master — try. Play one round of every activity the game offers (races, range, fishing, arcade, bowling and the rest) and the trophy pops. Use the Next up planner to see which types you have not touched; the game counts a try, not a win. Per the official list on Exophase; our advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting range and gold every challenge it offers. Gold means a high score, not just a pass — practise the weapon types you are weakest at first, and replay challenges freely: nothing here is missable. The number of challenges is set by the range itself, so check it in game. Per the official list on Exophase; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Drone races happen at several spots around Leonida: win one race at each location. Learn each course once, then race to win — losing a race costs nothing but time, and you can retry any location. Per the official list on Exophase; our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Twenty wins across twenty different races — repeats of the same race do not count twice, so vary your events: street races, drone races and any other race type the game offers. The counter (0/20) tracks your wins; a win is a win, whatever the vehicle. Per the official list on Exophase for the target of 20; PSNProfiles confirms the count. Our advice is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and challenge him to a fishing contest, then out-fish him. Fishing challenges reward patience and the right spot more than speed — if you lose, challenge him again. Per the official list on Exophase, which names Cal; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into an arcade, pick any game, and play it through to its end. One completion is all it takes — score does not matter. Per the official list on Exophase; our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand ends with a final mission: work through his missions in order and finish the last one. Contact strands are story-adjacent, so they cannot be missed while the story is open. Per the official list on Exophase, which names Andy; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's missions until the final one, then complete it. Per the official list on Exophase, which names Kenton; our advice is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand: play his missions in order to the final one. Per the official list on Exophase, which names Billy; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Eight stranger strands, scattered across the map: meet the strangers, play each strand to its end. The counter (0/8) tracks finished strands. Strangers appear as you explore, so keep an eye on the map while travelling. Per the official list on Exophase for the target of 8; PSNProfiles confirms the count. Our advice is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's missions through to the final one. Per the official list on Exophase, which names Randy; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand with its final mission. Per the official list on Exophase, which names Tyrone; our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are scattered across the state: visit each one and meditate. WATCH — this is the only confirmed missable in the set: spots are found as you travel, and no source confirms you can return to a missed spot, so meditate at every spot the moment you find it. The counter here has no number because the official description gives no count — the game itself will tell you how many spots exist. Per the official list on Exophase; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret wants one specific animal: find it, hunt it, and bring it back. Unique animals are one-of-a-kind hunts, so take the shot carefully — missing may or may not let you retry, and no source confirms either way. Track Bret's strand and hunt when you have the right weapon. Per the official list on Exophase, which names Bret; our advice is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collectible cards come in sets: complete any 3 full sets. Cards are found across Leonida, so collect as you explore and use the counter (0/3) to track finished sets. Per the official list on Exophase for the target of 3; PSNProfiles confirms the count. Our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. One hundred WAiNK spots: photograph or check in at each one. The counter (0/100) is the way to track them — a few per session adds up fast. Per the official list on Exophase for the target of 100; PSNProfiles confirms the count. Our advice is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Fifty challenges of any kind: missions, activities and world challenges all count toward the total. The counter (0/50) tracks them — just play broadly and they accumulate. Per the official list on Exophase for the target of 50; PSNProfiles confirms the count. Our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Use the countryside or water to break line of sight, and do not let your partner get caught. One clean escape is all it takes. Per the official list on Exophase; our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Three shops in a row, with your partner, while keeping your wanted level: plan a route of three nearby shops, hit them fast, and keep moving between them. The counter (0/3) counts consecutive robberies — getting busted resets the run. Per the official list on Exophase for the target of 3; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. One hundred different vehicles: drive anything new and it counts. The counter (0/100) tracks discoveries — vary your rides, steal what you have not driven, and check the list after each session. Per the official list on Exophase for the target of 100; PSNProfiles confirms the count. Our advice is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus once and drop five enemies before it ends. Pick a crowded fight, line up the shots, and do not waste the window — one use, five takedowns. The counter (0/5) is per-use, so a failed attempt just means trying again. Per the official list on Exophase for the target of 5; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the airport in a way the schedule never planned: the description points at VCIA itself, so the trick is the exit, not the flight. Improvise — steal a plane, a runway vehicle, anything that gets you out unscheduled. Per the official list on Exophase, which names VCIA; our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description is a joke with a hint: Rhinos are tanks, and the heat is the wanted level. Get into a Rhino and make the heat count — the trophy is about the tank, not the temperature. Per the official list on Exophase; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. A stealth robbery: get in, take the goods, and get out without ever being spotted. Plan the approach, watch the guards, and leave before the alarm. Detection fails the attempt, not the trophy — retry as needed. Per the official list on Exophase; our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vaults, five escapes: plan each robbery, grab the cash, and get out clean. The counter (0/5) tracks successful escapes — a busted robbery does not count, so escape first and count later. Per the official list on Exophase for the target of 5; PSNProfiles confirms the count. Our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck, take the money, and escape the heat. Trucks run set routes — find one, stop it, and be gone before backup arrives. One clean hit is enough. Per the official list on Exophase; our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Cover the whole map: every region, every corner of the state. Exploration counts by area, so travel widely rather than fast — the trophy is for seeing all of Leonida, not rushing through it. Per the official list on Exophase; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs an illegal operation somewhere in Leonida: rob one per gang. Learn which gang holds which turf, hit each operation once, and the trophy is yours. Per the official list on Exophase; our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. It is a moment, not a mission — sit down, take it in, and the trophy pops. Per the official list on Exophase, which names Ocean Beach; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive into a vehicle showroom and leave through the front — loudly. Classic style means no subtlety: pick a fast car, aim at the glass, and go. Per the official list on Exophase; our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through — play a frame properly, not just a single throw. Per the official list on Exophase, which names the alley; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — this is one of the cryptic trophies whose trigger is not confirmed by any source we checked. Our honest read: it relates to a partnership that draws a crowd, but the exact trigger is unconfirmed, so we will not invent one. Watch for a partnership activity with a public audience. Per the official list on Exophase; the trigger is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Another cryptic one: the description points at choices with consequences. Our honest read: it likely unlocks from a decision point in the story or a strand, but no source confirms which one, so we will not guess. Play the story, make your choices, and it will come. Per the official list on Exophase; the trigger is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Cryptic, and unconfirmed: the description suggests something that fails once and works the second time. Our honest read: it may be tied to retrying something after a first failure, but no source confirms what — we will not invent a method. Per the official list on Exophase; the trigger is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Cryptic, and unconfirmed: the description reads like a reaction to something strange. Our honest read: it likely involves an unusual event or easter egg somewhere in Leonida, but no source confirms which one, so we will not guess. Per the official list on Exophase; the trigger is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A drive-by with a melee weapon, aimed at bowling pins — or at bowlers. Get a vehicle, get a melee weapon, and bowl them over from the driver's seat. The joke is the method: melee, from a moving car. Per the official list on Exophase; our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies: take them to your contacts and launder them into clean cash. The counter ($0 / $250,000) tracks laundered money — keep robbing, keep laundering, and the total climbs. Per the official list on Exophase for the target of $250,000; PSNProfiles confirms the count. Our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. One hundred thousand dollars across the shops of Leonida: clothes, weapons, food, whatever the shops sell. Spending is the whole requirement — the counter ($0 / $100,000) tracks it, and big purchases move it fastest. Per the official list on Exophase for the target of $100,000; PSNProfiles confirms the count. Our advice is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property on the market. Garages are bought with cash, so this pairs with money-making — check property listings as you earn, and buy each garage once it is available. The number of garages is set by the game itself. Per the official list on Exophase; our guidance is our own, from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Ten vehicles registered in the Scooter Bros app: find vehicles, register them, and count up. The counter (0/10) tracks registrations — any ten vehicles will do. Per the official list on Exophase for the target of 10; PSNProfiles confirms the count. Our advice is drawn from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
